{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if any revenue values contain commas
print("Revenue values with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate_by_segment.max()

conversion_rate_by_segment, best_segment, best_rate"}
